text: Web: never re-syncs while open — collaborator changes invisible until reload (no poll/focus/manual refresh)
relates: T-89 (both touch useSync error/refresh surface)

Groomed 2026-07-16, design constraint from T-73 precedent: the user rejected tighter background polling on Android (battery/Doze made it not worth it), so keep web polling MODEST and strictly visible-tab-only — visibilitychange->visible, window online, and manual refresh are the primary mechanisms; the interval (90-120s, skip if a sync is already in flight, no polling while hidden) is a fallback, not the feature. A desktop tab has no Doze equivalent so a visible-only interval does not contradict T-73, but do not add background/hidden-tab polling.
